subject: general
question: Choose the correct meaning of idiom given below:**“Know which way the wind blows”**

options.text: Be aware of public opinion or trend

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Be aware of public opinion or trend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Know which way the wind blows"** means to be aware of public opinion, trends, or the prevailing circumstances. (सार्वजनिक राय या प्रवृत्ति को समझना)
 
 
• **Example:** Politicians often try to know which way the wind blows before making decisions on controversial issues.
 
 
• It emphasizes understanding the general mood or direction of things, especially to make informed or strategic decisions. (स्थिति की सामान्य दिशा को समझना)
